CanvasSection.description: An enumeration of the different sections of a business model canvas.
CanvasSection.title: CanvasSection

ERRCActionType.description: An enumeration of the different types of ERRC actions.
ERRCActionType.title: ERRCActionType

ErrcMove.description: Represents a move in the error correction system.

action.description: The action to be taken for error correction.

new_text.description: The text of the card after the action is applied. Required for reduce, raise and create (for reduce and raise it replaces the target card's text); must be omitted for eliminate.
examples: Self-serve customer onboarding in under 10 minutes
Production costs reduced by 15% through batch purchasing
new_text.title: New Text

opposite_side_impact.description: A description of how the action will impact the opposite side of the canvas.
examples: Eliminating this feature may reduce customer satisfaction.
Raising the price may increase revenue but could decrease demand.
opposite_side_impact.title: Opposite Side Impact

rationale.description: The rationale behind the action, explaining why it is necessary.
examples: This feature is not aligned with our core value proposition.
Reducing production costs will improve our profit margins.
rationale.title: Rationale

target_card_text.description: The exact current text of the existing card the action targets. Required for eliminate, reduce and raise; must be omitted for create.
target_card_text.title: Target Card Text

target_section.description: The section of the canvas that the action targets.
